general_information.Description: The UI/UX Design Specialization brings a design-centric approach to user interface and user experience design, and offers practical, skill-based instruction centered around a visual communications perspective, rather than on one focused on marketing or programming alone. In this sequence of four courses, students will summarize and demonstrate all stages of the UI/UX development process, from user research to defining a project’s strategy, scope, and information architecture, to developing sitemaps and wireframes. Students’ll learn current best practices and conventions in UX design and apply them to create effective and compelling screen-based experiences for websites or apps. Final Exam is included of Final Theory Exam (TE) & Final Practical Exam (PE): 100% Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded. Condition to pass: TE>=4 and PE>=4 and FR = (TE+PE)/2 + bonus >=5
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Student must get the certification of UI/UX Design Specialization specialization specialization from Coursera to be accepted to the final examination. 2. Complete the online course to be allowed to take Final Exam

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Explain underlying concepts and principles related to UI/UX design
Apply the key formal elements of clear, consistent, and intuitive UI design to the to the design of a static screen-based interface
Apply current best practices and conventions in UX design and employ the fundamental principles of how UX design functions to shape an audience's experience of a given body of content
Define the strategy and scope of the site, as well as develope its information architecture and overall structure
Apply the UX research to actual user interfaces: the creation of wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and clickable prototypes

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: All studied courses. Each module of course contributes 2-3 questions.
